open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions
open_points.text: “the alias is what the agent sees instead of the display name and the address” and “an alias whose content breaks that rule is not refused” contradict “No `personal_data` value reaches it” and “never to an agent”
open_points.question: When a permitted-length alias contains a person’s name, address or other identifying value, does Registry return it to the agent or enforce the guarantee that no personal data reaches the agent?
options: Accept it and return it to the agent, treating compliance solely as the owner’s responsibility
Accept it but suppress or replace it in agent outputs
Refuse it by inspecting its content
open_points.default_guess: Accept and return it because R0-90 explicitly says content violations are not refused.

witness.initial: An active project is granted to an agent session and has no alias.
events: The owner sets the alias to a customer’s name using 40 or fewer characters.
Registry accepts the alias because only its length is checked.
The agent reads the project projection through Cabinet Kernel.
outcomes: R0-90 and R0-82 give the agent the identifying alias.
R0-25, R0-26 and R0-74 prevent the personal value from reaching the agent.
witness.observer: The agent and its AI provider

open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions
open_points.question: What exactly counts as a character, and is the limit measured before or after any Unicode normalization?
open_points.default_guess: Count Unicode code points in the decoded, unmodified string.

events: The owner submits an alias consisting of 30 supplementary-plane emoji.
outcomes: The alias is accepted because it has 30 Unicode code points or grapheme clusters.
The alias is refused because it has 60 UTF-16 code units or more than 40 UTF-8 bytes.

open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions
open_points.text: “The alias is at most 40 characters” and “A project without an alias is shown to the agent by its id.”
open_points.question: Is an empty string a valid alias, and if accepted is it stored as an alias or treated as no alias?
options: Accept and store the empty string as an alias
Canonicalize the empty string to no alias
open_points.default_guess: Treat an empty string as no alias.

witness.initial: A project has a non-empty alias and is granted to an agent session.
events: The owner submits an empty string for the alias.
The agent reads the project projection.
outcomes: The change is accepted as a zero-character alias and the projection contains an empty alias.
The empty value clears or is refused, so the projection identifies the project by id or the change fails.
